verdict.rationale: Bolt.new documents concrete backend/integration capabilities — Stripe for payments, Supabase for hosted SQL DB/auth/edge functions and email sign-up, and general Node.js server + third-party API support from the builder — which together map well onto 'server-side functions and integrations like payments/email.' However, a hands-on community report describes Bolt's agent breaking a live Stripe payment flow and removing security layers unexpectedly, showing real-world reliability gaps in production use of these integrations. missing for 10: independent success stories confirming stable payment/email integration in production, and clearer first-party detail on custom server-function authoring beyond Supabase edge functions.
